notes: bambi sleepstudy.ipynb fits Reaction ~ Days + (Days|Subject) (Belenky et al. 2003 sleep-deprivation study; lme4 sleepstudy). Random slope of Days by Subject.

bambi hierarchical_binomial_bambi.ipynb: binomial p(H, AB) ~ 1 + (1|playerID), hits out of at-bats with player-specific intercepts (hierarchical logistic). Full Lahman Batting table; the notebook subsets but the survey uses the whole table. Many baseball columns (yearID, stint, teamID, lgID, G, R, 2B, HR, RBI, ...) are unused.

bambi serves this via load_data but its notebooks fit it no model; model from brms help example fit2 (Weibull frailty, McGilchrist & Aisbett 1991). Same data as brms kidney (folds). Censored survival time kept continuous, censored indicator ignored (Census brms-kidney rule). recur (1st/2nd recurrence) is an unused usable column.
MixedModels GLMM doc fits rate ~ 1 + period + (1|herd), Binomial, wts=hsz (incid cases out of herd size hsz). Mirror of lme4 cbpp (contagious bovine pleuropneumonia, Lunn & McNeil).

MixedModels constructors doc (Bernoulli GLMM). Mirror of mlmRev Contraception (Bangladesh Fertility Survey). abs2(age)=age^2 cannot be a separate column so age named once. age is centred continuous age stored as an Arrow category, declared continuous; livch an ordered count-of-children factor.
MixedModels constructors doc: intercept-only batch variance components. Mirror of lme4 Dyestuff (Davies 1947; 6 batches, 5 preparations each).

Mirror of lme4 grouseticks (Elston et al. 2001, Poisson glmer full_mod1). index is the observation-level random effect (one row per chick), so it stays in the formula but is listed in ignore, not grouping (OLRE rule). height is altitude stored as an Arrow category, declared continuous; year is a 3-level factor.

MixedModels constructors doc: crossed student (s) and lecturer (d) intercepts, service x dept fixed. Mirror of lme4 InstEval. y is a 1:5 teaching rating filed continuous per the lme4 InstEval rule (not a documented ordered factor; fit Gaussian). studage, lectage are unused columns.

formula: rt_raw ~ spkr * prec * load + (1 | subj) + (1 + prec | item)
notes: MixedModels formula_syntax doc (Kronmueller & Barr 2007, subj x item crossed, full 2x2x2 factorial). rt_trunc is the truncated-RT alternate response, ignored.

Mirror of nlme/MEMSS Machines (Milliken & Johnson 1992; Pinheiro & Bates 2000 App A.14): 6 workers each operate 3 machine brands 3 times, worker-by-machine random interaction. Worker:Machine composite built by the merge.

MovieLens 1M ratings: user g crossed with movie h, rating y. MixedModels benchmark model (crossed intercepts). y is a 1:5 rating filed continuous per the InstEval rule (Gaussian LMM). Response type set to ordinal by the #23 rule (ratings follow the column, not the Gaussian fit).

Langford, Bentham & McDonald 1998 (Stat Med), malignant-melanoma mortality vs UVB in the European Community; multilevel Poisson, counties nested in regions nested in nations, expected deaths as offset. county is the observation unit (one row each), region unique only within nation (nation:region composite). RULE GAP: no explicit MixedModels.jl formula found; model recalled from the published MLwiN mmmec example, confidence medium.

formula: rt ~ F + P + Q + lQ + lT + (1 | subj) + (1 | item)
notes: Masson, Rabe & Kliegl 2017 masked-priming lexical decision, subj x item crossed; factors F (frequency), P (priming), Q (stimulus quality), lQ/lT (previous-trial quality/type), response rt. trial is the trial-sequence index, ignored. RULE GAP: no MixedModels.jl formula found and the published factorial/interaction structure is not confirmed, so only main effects are filed, confidence medium.

Mirror of nlme Oxide / SASmixed Semi2 (Littell et al. 1996 p.155, semiconductor oxide-thickness variance components): wafers nested in lots, 3 sites per wafer. Rendered as the nlme random = ~1 | Lot/Wafer model; Source (2 levels) and Site (within-wafer replicate index) are unused columns.
MixedModels constructors doc: strength ~ 1 + (1|batch/cask). Mirror of lme4 Pastes (Davies & Goldsmith 1972); cask labels a-c repeat across batches, so the inner term is the batch:cask composite.
MixedModels constructors doc: crossed plate and sample random intercepts. Mirror of lme4 Penicillin (Davies & Goldsmith 1972, penicillin bioassay).
MixedModels constructors doc: random intercept and slope of days by subj. Mirror of lme4 sleepstudy (Belenky et al. 2003).

formula: r2 ~ 1 + anger + gender + btype + situ + mode + (1|subj) + (1|item)
notes: MixedModels constructors doc (Bernoulli GLMM, De Boeck & Wilson 2004). Mirror of lme4 VerbAgg; the MixedModels model uses main effects incl. mode (lme4 uses the 2-way interactions instead). resp is the ordered 3-level (no<perhaps<yes) alternate response of which r2 is the dichotomy, ignored.
